snippet.title: Deadhaus Sonata - Out Now in Early Access
snippet.description:
From the creator of Eternal Darkness and Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain, Denis Dyack, comes Deadhaus Sonata, a narrative-driven dark fantasy Action RPG where the undead rise against the living through brutal combat, six-player co-op, and player-driven systems designed to evolve over time.

Get the Game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1142050/Deadhaus_Sonata/
